declarations.label: indicator
declarations.documentation: Declare a reusable visual KX indicator.

declarations.label: study
declarations.documentation: Declare a KX research study. Studies may use report.* without placing orders.

declarations.label: strategy
declarations.documentation: Declare a deterministic KX backtest strategy using the single- or multi-asset broker runtime.

declarations.label: library
declarations.documentation: Declare a reusable KX module imported with `import library Alias from "Libraries/Name"`.

declarations.label: pipeline
declarations.documentation: Declare a KX data-engine pipeline. Pipelines may read workspace/global files, transform them with the native DuckDB service, validate output and register immutable dataset versions.

globalItems.label: isNa
globalItems.documentation: Return true for `na`/missing scalar or Series values.

globalItems.label: nz
globalItems.documentation: Replace `na`/missing scalar or Series values with a fallback (default 0).

globalItems.label: emit
globalItems.documentation: Emit a named scalar or numeric Series result from a KX Study/Indicator for host inspection.

ta.label: ta.returns
ta.documentation: Decimal simple return from N observations ago.

ta.label: ta.logReturns
ta.documentation: Natural-log return from N observations ago.

ta.label: ta.bbands
ta.documentation: Bollinger Bands object with basis, upper and lower Series.

ta.label: ta.crossover
ta.documentation: True where A crosses over B.

ta.label: ta.crossunder
ta.documentation: True where A crosses under B.

stats.label: stats.rank
stats.documentation: Cross-sectional rank; tied values receive their average rank.

data.label: data.current
data.documentation: Current OHLCV chart dataset.

data.label: data.security
data.documentation: Request another market instrument. Without an explicit range it follows the chart's loaded range.

data.label: data.market
data.documentation: Load a named OHLCV Data Library dataset and causally align it to the current script clock. Useful for portfolio strategies because the same dataset reference can route orders.

data.label: data.dataset
data.documentation: Load any imported dataset by id/name. Configured availability-time is the default causal timeline. For date-only observations without publication time, an explicit positive delay (for example 1d) provides a conservative availability assumption; otherwise KX warns that raw event time may not be point-in-time safe.

data.label: data.available
data.documentation: Check whether a named imported dataset exists.

data.label: data.list
data.documentation: List Data Library datasets by generic metadata filters. Returns ids by default; field can be id, name, symbol or summary.

data.label: data.align
data.documentation: Align timestamped data to the active chart timeline. previous/exact are no-lookahead.

data.label: data.filter
data.documentation: Filter a timestamped dataset by time and optional column comparisons.

data.label: data.resample
data.documentation: Resample timestamped data. OHLCV fields use open/high/low/close/volume-aware aggregation.

data.label: data.join
data.documentation: Join right-side timestamped columns onto the left dataset timeline with causal alignment by default.

data.label: data.engineStatus
data.documentation: Return native DuckDB engine and catalog information. Pipeline scripts only.

data.label: data.download
data.documentation: Pipeline-only native HTTPS download through a named connection. Credentials stay in the OS vault; returns an immutable raw path for data.read(). Jobs show progress and support cancellation/resume.

data.label: data.read
data.documentation: Create a lazy native data plan for a workspace/global CSV, JSON or Parquet file. No rows are copied into the KX interpreter.

data.label: data.select
data.documentation: Select columns in a native data plan.

data.label: data.rename
data.documentation: Rename columns in a native data plan.

data.label: data.sort
data.documentation: Sort a native data plan.

data.label: data.where
data.documentation: Filter rows with a typed native predicate.

data.label: data.dedupe
data.documentation: Deduplicate rows by one or more key columns.

data.label: data.fillTable
data.documentation: Fill null values in one native table column.

data.label: data.derive
data.insertText: data.derive(${1:table}, "${2:return}", "${3:close / lag(close) over (partition by symbol order by time) - 1}")
data.detail: data.derive(table, "return", "close / lag(close) over (partition by symbol order by time) - 1")
data.documentation: Add a DuckDB-backed derived column. Administrative/file-reading SQL is blocked.

data.label: data.normalizeTime
data.documentation: Normalize a timestamp column to epoch milliseconds.

data.label: data.joinBy
data.detail: data.joinBy(left, right, { left: ["symbol", "date"], right: ["symbol", "date"], how: "left", prefix: "right_" )
data.documentation: Relational join of two native data plans by explicit keys.

data.label: data.resampleOhlcv
data.insertText: data.resampleOhlcv(${1:table}, { timeColumn: "${2:time}", interval: "${3:1d}", open: "${4:open}", high: "${5:high}", low: "${6:low}", close: "${7:close}", volume: "${8:volume}" })
data.detail: data.resampleOhlcv(table, { timeColumn: "time", interval: "1d", open: "open", high: "high", low: "low", close: "close", volume: "volume" )
data.documentation: Native OHLCV resampling by an epoch-millisecond time column.

data.label: data.preview
data.documentation: Execute a native plan and return up to 1000 preview rows. Set includeTotal: false to skip a full count; totalRows is then a lower bound unless totalRowsExact is true. DATE/TIME/TIMESTAMP values are readable strings with nativeType labels.

data.label: data.validate
data.detail: data.validate(table, { requiredColumns: ["symbol", "time", "close"], types: { time: "number", close: "number" , timeColumn: "time", duplicateBy: ["symbol", "time"] )
data.documentation: Run native schema/type/timestamp/duplicate/OHLC/gap validation.

data.label: data.save
data.documentation: Write and register an immutable versioned output. Paths start at the chosen workspace/global root. Parquet defaults to ZSTD; CSV is uncompressed. Match the path extension to format. Existing registered versions and source files cannot be overwritten. The result includes fileLocation and an id for a pinned data.dataset reference.

series.label: series.shift
series.documentation: Shift a series by N bars.

series.label: series.pctChange
series.documentation: Decimal percentage change from N observations ago.

series.label: series.logReturn
series.documentation: Natural-log return from N observations ago.

series.label: series.changed
series.documentation: Boolean Series true when the current non-missing value differs from the previous observation; useful for detecting newly available events after causal alignment.

report.label: report.metric
report.documentation: Add a scalar metric to the Research Report.

report.label: report.table
report.documentation: Add a table to the Research Report.

report.label: report.line
report.documentation: Add a numeric series line chart to the Research Report.

report.label: report.histogram
report.documentation: Add a numeric histogram series to the Research Report.

input.label: input.int
input.documentation: Integer setting rendered in the KX Studio properties UI.

pane.label: pane.create
pane.documentation: Create or reference a named lower chart pane.

plot.label: plot.line
plot.documentation: Render a line. pane may be overlay, new/lower, a pane name, or numeric pane index.

plot.label: plot.bars
plot.documentation: Render OHLC bars from a dataset.

draw.label: draw.hline
draw.documentation: Horizontal price line on any chart pane.

draw.label: draw.ray
draw.documentation: Ray extending through the second point.

draw.label: draw.channel
draw.detail: draw.channel({ from: a, to: b, width: 1.0 )

array.label: array.get
array.documentation: Read an item by zero-based index.

array.label: array.set
array.documentation: Set an item by zero-based index and return the array.

array.label: array.includes
array.documentation: Check whether an array contains a value.

array.label: array.indexOf
array.documentation: Return the first matching index or -1.

array.label: array.unique
array.documentation: Return values with duplicates removed while preserving first occurrence.

array.label: array.sort
array.documentation: Return a sorted copy; direction is asc or desc.

map.label: map.delete
map.documentation: Delete a map key and return whether it existed.

set.label: set.create
set.documentation: Create a primitive-value set represented by a unique KX array.

set.label: set.add
set.documentation: Add a value if absent and return the set.

set.label: set.delete
set.documentation: Delete a value and return whether it existed.

object.label: object.has
object.documentation: Check whether an object contains a key.

object.label: object.merge
object.documentation: Shallow-merge two objects into a new object.

object.label: object.typeOf
object.documentation: Return KX runtime type: na, series, array, object, number, string, boolean or function.

session.label: session.define
session.documentation: Define a timezone-aware session. Days use Monday=1 through Sunday=7.

session.label: session.isOpen
session.documentation: Boolean Series indicating bars whose opening timestamp is inside the session.

session.label: session.isFirstBar
session.documentation: True on the first loaded bar that enters each session.

session.label: session.isLastBar
session.documentation: True on the last loaded bar before leaving each session.

time.label: time.day
time.documentation: Day of month in instrument timezone.

time.label: time.dayOfMonth
time.documentation: Alias for day of month in instrument timezone.

time.label: time.dayOfWeek
time.documentation: Weekday, Monday=1 through Sunday=7, in instrument timezone.

time.label: time.timestamp
time.documentation: Create an epoch-millisecond timestamp from local calendar parts, or pass an ISO-like string and optional timezone.

time.label: time.isBetween
time.documentation: Boolean Series for bars between two timestamps.

log.label: log.info
log.documentation: Write informational output to the KX Studio Output panel.

log.label: log.warn
log.documentation: Write warning output to the KX Studio Output panel.

log.label: log.error
log.documentation: Write error output to the KX Studio Output panel.

console.label: console.log
console.documentation: Write informational output to the KX Studio Output panel.

console.label: console.info
console.documentation: Write informational output to the KX Studio Output panel.

console.label: console.warn
console.documentation: Write warning output to the KX Studio Output panel.

console.label: console.error
console.documentation: Write error output to the KX Studio Output panel.

strategy.label: strategy.entry
strategy.documentation: Submit a market, limit, stop, or stop-limit entry. In portfolio mode dataset routes the order to a registered tradable instrument.

strategy.label: strategy.order
strategy.documentation: Submit a generic directional market, limit, stop, or stop-limit order. Generic orders bypass the entry pyramiding cap.

strategy.label: strategy.close
strategy.documentation: Close all or part of a named instrument entry at that instrument's next eligible bar open.

strategy.label: strategy.closeAll
strategy.documentation: Close every open portfolio position at each instrument's next eligible bar open. Optional qty/qtyPercent can reduce them instead.

strategy.label: strategy.exit
strategy.insertText: strategy.exit("${1:Long Exit}", { dataset: "${2:dataset_name}", from: "${3:Long}", qtyPercent: ${4:50}, stop: ${5:stopPrice}, limit: ${6:targetPrice} })
strategy.detail: strategy.exit("Long Exit", { dataset: "dataset_name", from: "Long", qtyPercent: 50, stop: stopPrice, limit: targetPrice )
strategy.documentation: Attach/update an independent stop, target, partial scale-out, or trailing exit on the primary or named portfolio instrument.

strategy.label: strategy.cancel
strategy.documentation: Cancel a pending order by id on the primary or specified portfolio instrument.

strategy.label: strategy.cancelAll
strategy.documentation: Cancel all pending entry orders.

strategy.label: strategy.position
strategy.documentation: Inspect live position state for a named portfolio instrument.

strategy.label: strategy.positionSizeOf
strategy.documentation: Signed live position size for a named portfolio instrument.

strategy.label: strategy.positionAvgPriceOf
strategy.documentation: Average live position price for a named portfolio instrument.

strategy.label: strategy.openPnlOf
strategy.documentation: Unrealised P&L for a named portfolio instrument.

strategy.label: strategy.positionSideOf
strategy.documentation: Live long/short side for a named portfolio instrument.

strategy.label: strategy.positionBarsHeldOf
strategy.documentation: Instrument bars/sessions held for a named live portfolio position.

strategy.label: strategy.positionEntryTimeOf
strategy.documentation: Entry timestamp for a named live portfolio position, or na while flat.

strategy.label: strategy.long
strategy.documentation: Long strategy direction constant.

strategy.label: strategy.short
strategy.documentation: Short strategy direction constant.

strategy.label: strategy.positionSize
strategy.documentation: Signed live broker position size at the current completed bar: positive long, negative short, zero flat.

strategy.label: strategy.positionAvgPrice
strategy.documentation: Current broker average position price, or na when flat.

strategy.label: strategy.positionEntryTime
strategy.documentation: Primary/current position entry timestamp, or na when flat.

strategy.label: strategy.positionBarsHeld
strategy.documentation: Primary/current position bars/sessions held, including the entry bar.

strategy.label: strategy.cash
strategy.documentation: Current realised broker cash/balance after commissions and closed P&L.

strategy.label: strategy.equity
strategy.documentation: Current marked-to-market equity at the completed bar close.

strategy.label: strategy.openPnl
strategy.documentation: Current unrealised P&L at the completed bar close.

strategy.label: strategy.pendingOrders
strategy.documentation: Count of currently pending/queued broker orders.

strategy.label: strategy.availableCash
strategy.documentation: Shared account cash currently available for new fills.

strategy.label: strategy.buyingPower
strategy.documentation: Current account buying power. currently equals available cash; separate for future leverage rules.

strategy.label: strategy.openPositions
strategy.documentation: Number of simultaneously open portfolio positions.

strategy.label: strategy.grossExposure
strategy.documentation: Absolute market notional across all open positions.

strategy.label: strategy.netExposure
strategy.documentation: Signed market notional across all open positions.

strategy.label: strategy.grossExposurePct
strategy.documentation: Gross exposure as a percentage of account equity.

strategy.label: strategy.netExposurePct
strategy.documentation: Net exposure as a percentage of account equity.
